title: Encrypted DNS Provisioning RFC 9464 Client Policy Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, DNS package build, full solution test, and diff hygiene for the RFC 9464 client provisioning policy surface.
scope: This verification covers malformed attribute rejection before policy use, preference for encrypted DNS resolvers when classic INTERNAL_IP*_DNS addresses are also present, use of conveyed ENCDNS_IP* addresses as encrypted resolver session targets, ADN and SHA2-256 SubjectPublicKeyInfo digest certificate validation decisions, non-recoverable resolver certificate validation failure, split-tunnel INTERNAL_DNS_DOMAIN routing to ENCDNS_IP* resolvers, allowance for INTERNAL_DNS_DOMAIN without classic DNS attributes, and rejection of non-preconfigured NULL-authenticated responder data.
preconditions: The RFC 9464 specification exists as canonical JSON at `specs/requirements/quic/SPEC-QUIC-RFC9464.json`.
Client policy receives decoded ENCDNS_IP* and ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO attributes from an IKEv2/IPsec adapter.
expected_result: The focused client-policy tests pass, the DNS package builds, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9464 artifacts, generated triage reflects the client-policy slice, diff hygiene passes, and the full solution test suite remains green.
status_summary: The RFC 9464 client provisioning policy is trace-owned and verified. Full IKEv2 exchange integration and host resolver installation remain future adapter work.
